note: Valley-oak riparian forest campground on the Stanislaus River southwest of Ripon, in one of the last old-growth riparian oak woodlands of the Central Valley. Pick a 24-ft site when booking: there is no overflow parking. --Claude
summary: Caswell Memorial SP: $30 flat confirmed, no hookups, pay showers, flush toilets; year-round, max stay 30; strictly 24 ft max and only 10 of 64 sites take a 23-ft rig (13, 45, 46, 49, 52, 55, 57, 59, 62, 64). Parts of the park closed for flood damage (campground bookable). Phone empty -> (209) 599-3810. Pin ~375 m off at the entrance -> move proposed. Not waterfront confirmed (canopy).
flags: FIT: alert 'Max length is strictly 24'' with only ten 24-ft sites (13, 45, 46, 49, 52, 55, 57, 59, 62, 64); 39 sites are 18 ft and 9 are 21 ft. A 23-ft rig fits the ten - keep, but the note says to book a 24-ft site. The old note's 'trailers to 21 ft' came from the 2018 brochure; RDR now lists trailers to 24 ft as well.
